_aide.fichier: Settings of the texture (.tex) encoding done by tools/png2tex.py. Read at EVERY texture write: a change applies at the next build, without rebuilding the exe (but an SM3 Studio.exe that is already open keeps the old png2tex in memory: restart it after updating tools/). Missing file, missing key or invalid value: default value. Keys starting with _ are comments, ignored by the tool. The keys are French and must stay as they are: encodeur = encoder, lissage = smoothing, actif = active, rayon = radius, garde_noir = black guard, mips_couleur = colour mips, normale = normal map, fondu = fade, renormaliser = renormalise, dilatation = dilation, anneaux = rings, fond = background, par_texture = per texture, tissu = fabric, seuil_fil = web-line threshold, format_force = forced format, taille_max = maximum size, plaquer = flatten, noir = black.
_aide.encodeur: "hq" (default): high-quality DXT encoder (principal axis + least squares + nearest 565 rounding, the block that DECODES best is kept), about 10 s for a 4096 DXT5 chain. "rapide" (fast): the old encoder (luminance min/max, truncated 565), dark blocks along the web lines.
_aide.lissage: CIELAB bilateral filter applied to mip 0 of COLOUR textures in DXT, outside the background: it erases the bake noise that DXT turns into dirty blocks and keeps the edges (web lines). actif true/false; rayon (radius) in texels (0 = nothing); sigma_spatial in texels; sigma_couleur (colour sigma) in dE (larger = also smooths stronger colour differences). garde_noir (black guard) [L0, L1] in L*: a texel darker than L0 stays raw, a texel lighter than L1 is fully smoothed, blended in between -- it protects the thin blacks (gaps between the symbiote's scales) that the filter used to wash out to grey; [0, 0] = no guard. Never applied in ARGB8 (lossless).
_aide.mips_couleur: "srgb" (default, as before): 2x2 average of the sRGB values. "lineaire" (linear): average in linear light (physically right: thin light/dark details keep their average brightness at a distance).
_aide.normale_fondu: Suit normal map (0x61DCA273, X in the alpha, Y in the green): relief factor per mip level, 1 = full relief, 0 = flat. The last number applies to every following level. The sub-texel relief of the web lines only shimmers beyond mip 2. With normale_renormaliser false, these numbers are EXACTLY those of the red-suit normal map validated in game (relief = f x mean slope).
_aide.normale_renormaliser: false (default): mips = 2x2 average of x and y, linear fade (f*x, f*y), like the red-suit normal map validated in game. true: average of (x,y,z) renormalised, then normalise(f*x, f*y, z) -- keeps about 20 % more relief at mips 2-5 for the same fade.
_aide.dilatation: Filling of the BACKGROUND (texels with RGB exactly 0,0,0, or alpha 0 if the image has a real alpha) before each reduction, so that the mips do not darken the edges of the UV islands. anneaux (rings) = texels filled per level. fond_min_pct: below this share of background (in %), the atlas is considered already dilated and its blacks are content (nothing is touched).
_aide.par_texture: Settings for ONE texture: key = its hash ("0x0133FD92"), value = the same keys as above (only those given change). This table REPLACES the default one: {} = no exception. By default, the black suit atlas (0x0133FD92): no bilateral filter, lissage_tissu active, ARGB8 2048 (validated in game on 2026-10-06). To go back to the old look (DXT5 4096, pattern kept): "0x0133FD92": {"lissage": {"actif": false}}.
_aide.lissage_tissu: Smoothing of the BASE of the fabric of a dark atlas. Web lines, logos and eyes (texels whose sRGB lightness is >= seuil_fil, grown by fil_dilate texels) are kept as they are; the rest gets a gaussian blur of `sigma` texels in linear light; detail 0 = plain fabric, 1 = pattern kept. Made for the BLACK suit, where the bilateral filter is blind (everything sits below L* 3): the scale pattern on an almost-black background was the grain seen in game. Off by default, turned on through par_texture for 0x0133FD92.
_aide.format_force: "" (default) = the format chosen in Studio; "ARGB8" / "DXT5" / "DXT1" = force this format on the texture (colour atlas; a normal map always stays DXT5). The black atlas is ARGB8: DXT cannot render near-blacks (purple/green stains).
_aide.taille_max: 0 (default) = no limit; otherwise mip 0 is reduced (2x2 sRGB average) down to this size. ARGB8 2048 = same file size as DXT5 4096.
_aide.normale_plaquer: [low, high] in degrees: the WEAK relief of the normal map (smoothed slope < low) is flattened, the strong relief (> high, the edges of the web) is kept. [0, 0] (default) = nothing.
_aide.noir_normale_plaquer: What the BLACK suit chain (blacksuit_package) applies to ITS normal map (slot 0x61DCA273 is shared with the red suit, hence a separate key): [9, 14] = flat fabric, web kept, the version validated in game on 2026-10-06. [0, 0] = relief of the scales kept.
